question: Within 130 kilometers, where can I find a museum aligned with the route to Tappan Zee Hotel, Nyack, NY from White Memorial Foundation, Litchfield, CT?
sql: WITH start_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%White Memorial Foundation%' LIMIT 1 ), end_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Tappan Zee Hotel%' LIMIT 1 ), route_segment AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(sl.geometry, el.geometry) AS geom FROM start_location sl, end_location el ), buffered_route AS ( -- Create a 5 km buffer around the direct route to define "aligned with the route" SELECT ST_Buffer(rs.geom::geography, 5000)::geometry AS geom FROM route_segment rs ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_location sl_ref, -- Reference start_location for the DWithin distance check buffered_route br WHERE p.museum IS NOT NULL -- Filter for museums AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, br.geom::geography) -- Museum is aligned with the route AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sl_ref.geometry::geography, 130000); -- Museum is within 130 km of the starting point
